infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MotoRadar shows nearby riders on the map while the app is open.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: MotoRadar can track your ride in the background so other riders can see you and reach you in an emergency.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MotoRadar needs access to your photos to add ride memories and motorcycle photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MotoRadar needs permission to save ride posters to your Photos.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MotoRadar needs camera access to take motorcycle photos.
